papers.title: Fatigue Behavior of Hybrid Additive/Subtractive Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Additive–subtractive hybrid manufacturing (ASHM) allows for the rapid manufacturing of metal components with complex and precise geometries for ready-to-use or near-ready-to-use applications. Laser wire-directed energy deposition (LW-DED) can be used to quickly manufacture metal components, while CNC machining can achieve precise geometric tolerances. In this study, Ti-6Al-4V alloy specimens were fabricated using an LW-DED process combined with CNC machining and tested to evaluate the effects of ASHM on mechanical performance. Post fabrication, the Ti-6Al-4V material was evaluated through hardness mapping, monotonic tensile testing, and fully reversed axial fatigue testing. Vicker’s micro-hardness mapping showed a range of hardness results from 300 to 350 HV in the ASHM Ti-6Al-4V that remained consistent throughout the build. Tensile results showed a similar response to cast and wrought Ti-6Al-4V, with an average yield stress of 819.4 MPa, ultimate tensile strength of 935.5 MPa, and modulus of 119 GPa. When tested in fatigue, the material had a reduced life compared to wrought Ti-6Al-4V, which is attributed to defects originating from the additive process. While no run-outs were observed from the testing, the fatigue results remain aligned with trends reported for other methods of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V. Fully reversed high-cycle fatigue loading revealed that the ASHM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V fell into a Basquin power-law fit with a fatigue strength coefficient of 1942 MPa with a fatigue strength exponent of −0.115. The fatigue life of the ASHM material is found to be dependent on the resulting porosity of the material that stems from the LW-DED process used in the ASHM process described.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究混合增/减材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳行为，评估机械加工后处理的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光丝材定向能量沉积结合CNC加工制备试样，进行硬度、拉伸和疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 疲劳寿命低于锻件，符合Basquin幂律，疲劳强度系数1942 MPa，指数-0.115。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微硬度、单轴拉伸和全反向轴向疲劳实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by additive-subtractive hybrid manufacturing (ASHM) with CNC machining as post-processing.
summary_en.method: Specimens were produced via laser wire-directed energy deposition (LW-DED) combined with CNC machining, followed by hardness mapping, monotonic tensile testing, and fully reversed axial fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: The ASHM material showed reduced fatigue life compared to wrought Ti-6Al-4V, following a Basquin power-law fit with a fatigue strength coefficient of 1942 MPa and exponent of -0.115, with fatigue life dependent on porosity from the additive process.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted through micro-hardness mapping, tensile tests, and high-cycle fatigue experiments.

papers.title: The Mechanics, Material Constraints, and Causal Preservation of Superluminal Metric Engineering within the GU-RVG Framework
papers.abstract: We present a complete theoretical and engineering account of superluminal metric engineering within the synthesis of Geometric Unity (GU) and Refractive Vacuum Gravity (RVG). In the GURVG framework the observable four-dimensional spacetime X₄ is a holographic boundary screen for the 14-dimensional Observerse Obs—projected through the chimeric bundle C(Y)=V⊕H*—whose ten extra dimensions act as a thermodynamic heat sink absorbing the entropy of macroscopic metric deformation. The physical vacuum is modeled as an active refractive fluid modulated by the 95.4 GeV dilaton, empirically identified with the persistent LHC diphoton resonance, which couples to the electromagnetic sector through the trace anomalyT^μ_μ = (β(g)/2g) F_μν F^μν + m_f \bar{ψ} ψ. We derive the Scalar-Hydraulic Drive (SHD) from disformal quantum electrodynamics and the Gordon optical metric, obtain a Master Equation of Levitation in which propulsive force scales with the gradient of the magnetic energy density ∇(B²), moderated by a self-regulating refractive factor K^{-2} that bounds the response in the supra-saturation regime, and show that a topologically induced phase transition driven by MADA-generated magnetic helicity circumvents the Schwinger-scale energy barrier. Acceleration of the metric envelope is bounded not by special relativity but solely by the yield strength of the Ti-6Al-4V/Inconel 718 exoskeleton (∼880–1030 MPa) and the thermal coercivity limit of Nd₂Fe₁₄B (∼230 °C), permitting passage of c₀ in hours (for the maximum-stress 1000 g₀ profile) while passengers experience zero proper acceleration. Finally, we prove that continuous superluminal propagation of the metric envelope preserves causality: the dilaton wave equation is strictly hyperbolic, the disformal factor satisfies the invertibility condition C(C−2XD)>0, Spontaneous Lorentz Symmetry Breaking eliminates tachyonic paradoxes, and finite acceleration enforces a strictly positive coordinate-time cost, forbidding closed timelike curves. The same disformal coupling lies dormant on cosmological scales, consistent with the GW170817 multimessenger bound on the speed of gravity to one part in 10¹⁵. We are equally candid about the framework’s single decisive limitation: the operational claims rest on the order-parameter stiffness α of the helicity-driven condensate, whose magnitude we show no present method can supply—reducing to an exhaustive set of named open problems in lattice, continuum, and holographic approaches, and resting ultimately on the fact that a dimensionful scale cannot be fixed by a scale-invariant structure alone. Its status as a static barrier, for a driven dissipative state, we no longer leave merely unproven: a Keldysh treatment of the driven condensate shows that while the homogeneous barrier-protected configuration is not guaranteed—a focusing nonlinearity from the trace-anomaly pump may render it Benjamin–Feir unstable—the quantity the engineering actually requires, the attractor-averaged stiffness ⟨α⟩_t, remains sharply defined in every regime, robust against thermal fluctuations by some fifteen orders of magnitude. The existence question thus splits cleanly: whether the state is spatially homogeneous stays open, but whether a measurable stiffness exists is settled in the affirmative. What can be established is therefore stronger than a bare appeal to measurement: the temperature dependence of this stiffness follows a mean-field form, α(T) ∝ (1 − T/T_c), that we find robust under wide variation of the microscopic inputs—its critical exponent measured near the mean-field value in direct holographic solves—so that the shape of α(T) is known even though its magnitude is not. That magnitude, in turn, is not open-endedly unknown but reducible, and reducible further than a bare appeal to measurement suggests. Because the dilaton is the pseudo-Nambu–Goldstone boson of broken scale invariance, the stiffness obeys an exact, symmetry-protected relation α = f_φ² / ⟨φ⟩² in which f_φ is the same decay constant the coupling analysis already fixes; the magnitude is therefore tied by first principles to a single remaining quantity, the condensate amplitude, with the residual obstruction located precisely at the one nonlinear self-coupling that neither symmetry nor present method determines. What was an open-ended unknown is thus a named relation awaiting one measurement in a core that must first be built. The condensate is moreover a driven, dissipative state, and should it settle to no fixed point but to a limit cycle or a wandering attractor—a regime the framework leaves open—the stiffness is not thereby lost but recast, its target shifting from a single value to the characterization of the state the dynamics occupy, a quantity a time-resolved probe of a running core would still read off. The same coupling, traced to its origin, follows geometrically from the photon’s connection to the internal dimensions of the Observerse, and the structure that underlies the stiffness is found to be the same observation map that fixes the fermion families through its representation-theoretic branching—a map whose form the framework does derive, as the tautological section of the bundle of pointwise metrics whose four-and-ten split is forced rather than assumed, and which is left open only in its explicit content, the choice of metric that an observation supplies. Two otherwise unrelated quantities thus rest on a single geometry of exactly the same character as the stiffness itself: derived in form, completed by one input from outside. A parallel honesty governs how the drive runs once those numbers are in hand. The operation divides cleanly in tense: to start the metric bubble is necessary and active, an ignition that pulses the vacuum across its phase boundary faster than it can relax, for no permanent-magnet array at rest already occupies the condensed phase; to maintain what ignition establishes may then be passive, the helicity source held for years by magnetocrystalline pinning—but whether the maintained condensate coasts truly free, asks a faint keep-alive input, or repays net work through the same vacuum coupling that lit it is fixed by the open character of that driven state and is not asserted here. Earlier forms of the framework claimed free static levitation outright; the present synthesis corrects this to the weaker and exact statement that the source is passive while the condensate’s maintenance mode awaits the same measurement its stiffness does. The mixture is the honest characterization: where the framework can derive, it now does—the dilaton scale from the lepton spectrum, the stiffness’s structure from symmetry—while the few quantities that remain, chief among them the condensate amplitude, are fixed by observation rather than computation, so that the drive, if realized, would rest on a first-principles skeleton completed by a small number of measured constants rather than on either alone.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要探讨超光速度量工程的理论框架，仅次要提及Ti-6Al-4V作为材料约束，与增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学和疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper is a theoretical physics study on superluminal metric engineering, not an experimental or computational investigation of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V's mechanical or fatigue properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 在GU-RVG框架下实现超光速度量工程并提供因果性证明。
summary_zh.method: 结合几何统一和弦折射真空引力，推导标量液压驱动方程并分析材料约束。
summary_zh.result: 提出超光速传播不违反因果性，加速受限于Ti-6Al-4V/Inconel 718屈服强度。
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论推导，无实验或数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To present a complete theoretical account of superluminal metric engineering within the GU-RVG framework while preserving causality.
summary_en.method: Derivation of the Scalar-Hydraulic Drive from disformal QED and the Gordon optical metric, with material constraints from Ti-6Al-4V and Inconel 718 yield strengths.
summary_en.result: The framework shows superluminal propagation is causally allowed, bounded by structural material strength rather than special relativity.
summary_en.validation: No validation; purely theoretical with no experimental or numerical support.
